messages:
Marta: Heads-up — starting an early-prefill eval for titan-13b-quant with speculative decoding. Running a ~5k holdout quick-sanity run now, will post logs here. Ping if you want to join the canary.
Jonah: Can you drop the minimal checklist? what configs + batch sizes are we using?
Marta: Quick checklist: model=titan-13b-q8, decode=speculative, spec_budget=3, fallback=deterministic, batch_size=8, kv_cache=true, prefix_caching=on. Run command below:
```
./rwdctl run --model titan-13b-q8 --decode speculative --spec-budget 3 \
  --batch 8 --kv-cache on --fallback deterministic --evalset 5k_holdout
```
Priya: Quick QA: are we using the exact same prompt templates as the baseline? last time mismatched templates caused a rouge drop.
Marta: Yes — same templates + paired A/B evaluation so differences should be comparable.
Sam: Watch OOM on 8-bit q8 when batch > 8 on our prod GPUs. We saw OOM at batch=12 in the last run.
Marta: Noted, capping batch at 8 for the smoke. Also enabling streaming early-exit logging to capture partial outputs.
ops-bot: CI job 4680123456-spec-run started on runner-gpu-12 (node=rwd-g12).
Jonah: What metrics should we watch live? ppl/nll, rouge, safety_flag_rate, latency_p90?
Priya: Add toxicity_regressions and hallucination_count from the eval harness. Beam diversity might help understand instability.
Marta: Collecting: ppl, nll, rouge, bleu, safety_flags, hallucination_count, latency p50/p90/p99, cost-per-token.
Sam: Also capture kv-cache-hit-rate and speculative-abort-rate (how often we fall back).
Marta: Initial quick numbers (first 200 prompts):
```
baseline deterministic:  ppl=12.3, rouge=0.42, safety=0.30%, lat_p90=180ms
speculative (spec_budget=3): ppl=12.7, rouge=0.40, safety=0.35%, lat_p90=120ms, abort_rate=6%
```
Priya: ~0.02 drop in rouge is small, but safety +0.05% is concerning. I'll flag safety-critical prompts for manual review.
Jonah: Can we run a budget sweep (spec_budget=1..4) to get a tradeoff curve? also try q4/q8 quant levels.
Marta: Scheduling sweeps for budget=1..4 across quant levels q4 and q8. Will pin RNG seeds for reproducibility.
Sam: Suggest doing the smoke on the dedicated pool first to avoid noisy neighbors skewing p99s.
Marta: Agreed. Plan: 1) smoke on dedicated; 2) run sweep overnight; 3) paired A/B on 1% traffic; 4) human eval for any flagged safety regressions. Timeline: smoke today, sweep tomorrow.
Priya: +1 — I'll spin up a small eval dashboard for quick safety spot checks.
Jonah: Thanks. @Marta leave the artifacts link here when available.
Marta: Uploaded logs & CSV: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/4680123456/spec-prefill-run-2026-03-21.csv :thumbsup:
ops-bot: CI job 4680123456-spec-run completed: success (12/12 steps). artifacts uploaded.
Sam: OK — reconvene if we hit non-trivial regressions. If not, proceed with gradual rollout and monitor the safety dashboards closely.
